author: Kevin Stratvert
description:
Learn how to build AI agents in Jira using Atlassian Rovo step by step. In this tutorial, you'll start with a pre-built AI agent and then create your own custom agent from scratch. You'll learn how to add company knowledge from Confluence, connect skills like Slack notifications, and automate agent workflows so they run whenever new Jira issues are created.

By the end of this video, you'll know how to build, customize, test, and deploy AI agents that can analyze support requests, recommend actions, draft responses, and automate work across your organization.

Host: Kevin Stratvert
Sponsor: Atlassian
